title: Homology with constant differential ranks on a reduced scheme
statement: Let Y be a reduced scheme [def-pc-reduced-scheme], P a cochain complex of modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and choose bases P^n ≅ O_Y^{r(n)} [def-weil-pbc-free-module] for every n ∈ Z. Fix q ∈ Z, an open immersion j:Z→Y [def-weil-open-immersion], and natural numbers a,b. Let A and B be the matrices of d^q and d^{q-1} in these bases. Suppose that for every z∈Z there is a field R and a morphism g:Spec R→Y with image exactly {j(z)} for which rank(A(g))=a and rank(B(g))=b [def-weil-matrix-rank]. Then H^q(j^*P) is finite locally free of rank r(q)-a-b [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module], with natural subtraction. Neither boundedness of P nor a proper morphism producing P is required.

source.place: Proof of (3), reduced-ring normal-form claim and the following kernel/image splitting argument (the existing DAG node records the full source text).

proof.text: Apply the constant-rank kernel and image theorem to the outgoing differential on the open pullback, using the chosen free bases and the field-valued singleton-image hypothesis. It gives a finite locally free outgoing kernel of rank r(q)-a.
Apply the same theorem to the incoming differential. It gives a finite locally free incoming image of rank b and local retractions of its inclusion.

The complex identity identifies the incoming image with a subobject of the outgoing kernel. The locally split short-complex homology theorem therefore identifies the homology with a finite locally free sheaf of rank (r(q)-a)-b.
The three-term short-complex homology is canonically isomorphic to the degree-q homology of the pulled-back homological complex; transport finite local freeness across this isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_homology_pullback_of_constantRank
    {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsReduced Y] {P : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ} {r : ℤ → ℕ}
    (e : ∀ n, P.X n ≅ free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin (r n))))
    (q : ℤ) (j : Z ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j] (a b : ℕ)
    (hrank : ∀ z : Z, ∃ (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (_ : IsField R) (g : Spec R ⟶ Y),
      Set.range g.base = {j.base z} ∧
      ((freeMatrix ((e q).inv ≫ P.d q (q + 1) ≫ (e (q + 1)).hom)).map g.appTop).rank = a ∧
      ((freeMatrix ((e (q - 1)).inv ≫ P.d (q - 1) q ≫ (e q).hom)).map g.appTop).rank = b) :
    ((((Modules.pullback j).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P).homology q).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank
       (r q - a - b)
